source: client product brief — E-4812 / 4812 (-196°C LN2 storage material)

tagline.en: −196°C liquid-nitrogen storage · direct-apply to frozen surfaces · up to 10 freeze-thaw cycles
tagline.zh: −196℃ 液氮冻存 · 冷冻表面直贴 · 耐 10 次反复冻融

positioning.en: Purpose-built identification labels for frozen laboratory sample containers — polypropylene (PP) cryovials, test tubes and storage boxes (PP and cardboard). Rated for storage from −150°C to −196°C (liquid-nitrogen environments), it keeps information clearly legible across the sample's entire frozen-storage lifecycle. It also survives repeated thaw-and-refreeze cycles — up to 10 cycles of thawing at room temperature or in warm / ice water followed by refreezing.
positioning.zh: 该产品专为冷冻实验室样品容器的识别标签而设计，适用于聚丙烯（PP）冷冻小瓶、试管和存储盒（PP 和纸板）。存储温度范围在 −150°C 至 −196°C（液氮环境）。信息可确保在样品整个冷冻存储生命周期内保持清晰可识别。该产品还能承受多次解冻和冷冻循环——最多可承受 10 次在室温或温水／冰水中解冻后再冷冻的循环。

en: Ultra-low-temp direct application: 7 N initial tack lets you label frozen surfaces directly — no need to thaw the sample, for a simpler, faster workflow.
Strong adhesion retention: stays firmly bonded through long-term liquid-nitrogen storage without loosening or falling off, preventing sample mix-ups.
Withstands up to 10 freeze-thaw cycles: wide temperature tolerance means no cracking, peeling or degradation across repeated cycles, keeping the mark intact.

Broad facestock compatibility: waterproof, oil-resistant and chemical-resistant, compatible with multiple print methods. For variable data, pair a thermal-transfer printer with an ultra-low-temperature resin ribbon for crisp, durable print.
zh: 超低温直贴：初粘力达 7N，可以直接贴于冷冻的表面，无需解冻样本，操作更便捷。
持粘性强：可以长时间存储在液氮中，也不会松动脱落，牢固贴合，避免样本混淆。
可耐受高达 10 次反复冻融循环：宽温度耐受，多次冻融也不会破裂、剥落、降解，保证标识完整。
面材适配性广：防水，抗油，耐化学，适配多种印刷方式。可变信息打印，使用热转印打印机搭配超低温树脂碳带，确保信息清晰持久。

en: No warm-up needed — label directly at −80°C or in liquid nitrogen without thawing, so the sample never has to return to room temperature and its viability and integrity are protected.
Stays firmly attached — through long-term liquid-nitrogen storage the label stays bonded and never lifts, preventing mislabeling and sample mix-ups and safeguarding traceability.
Survives repeated freeze-thaw — withstands up to 10 freeze-thaw cycles, keeping identification clear and intact even after the sample is retrieved and refrozen many times.
Clear, durable data — thermal transfer with an ultra-low-temperature resin ribbon keeps information legible across the entire frozen lifecycle, reducing manual-checking errors.
zh: 样本无需回温 —— 可在 −80℃ 及液氮环境下直接贴标，样本无需解冻回到常温，最大程度保护样本活性与完整性。
标识牢固不脱落 —— 长期液氮存储中标签牢固贴合、不松动脱落，避免样本错标与混淆，保障全程可追溯。
耐反复冻融 —— 可耐受最多 10 次冻融循环，样本多次取用、反复冻存后标识依旧清晰完整。
信息清晰持久 —— 热转印搭配超低温树脂碳带，冷冻全周期信息清晰可读，减少人工核对差错。

cells.en: White biaxially-oriented (BOPP) film with excellent flexibility.
cells.zh: 白色双向拉伸薄膜，具备优异柔韧性。

cells.en: Ultra-clear biaxially-oriented (BOPP) film for curved-surface application and a "no-label", ultra-transparent look.
cells.zh: 超透明双向拉伸薄膜，适用于曲面贴合，及需要实现超透明无标签视觉效果的场景。

cells.en: Wrap-around self-laminating label for thin tubes and cryovials — protects printed information for lasting, clear legibility.
cells.zh: 环绕自覆膜标签，适合细管、冻存管等，更好保护信息持久、清晰。

cells.en: White, flexible, coated biaxially-oriented film from a co-extruded polymer blend.
cells.zh: 一种白色、柔韧、涂布处理的双向拉伸薄膜，由共挤聚合物混合物制成。

cells.en: Flexo, screen, offset and UV inkjet; thermal transfer with a specific wax-resin or resin ribbon.
cells.zh: 适用于柔印、丝网印刷、胶印和 UV 喷墨印刷方法；可使用特定的蜡-树脂或树脂色带进行热转印打印。

zh: 以上为参考性典型值；量产前请以最新技术数据表为准并经应用测试确认。
